neighbours.label: the token ' shrink' (also ' shrinking', 'sh|rank')
fire: Wool sweaters tend to shrink if you wash them in hot water.
The glacier has been shrinking steadily for the past fifty years.
Each box of cereal arrives sealed in clear shrink wrap.
Analysts expect the economy to shrink by two percent this year.
Her savings began to shrink after she lost the second job.
The town's population is shrinking as young people move away.
Cotton jeans often shrink a little in the dryer.
Without water the leaves shrink and curl at the edges.
quiet: Wool sweaters tend to stretch if you hang them while wet.
The glacier has been melting steadily for the past fifty years.
Each box of cereal arrives sealed in clear plastic film.
Analysts expect the economy to contract by two percent this year.
Her savings began to dwindle after she lost the second job.
The town's population is declining as young people move away.
Cotton jeans often fade a little in the dryer.
Without water the leaves wither and curl at the edges.

notes: Card: ' shrink' x18, ' shrinking' x5 of the top 32. Not probed; near misses are synonyms (contract, dwindle, wither).
